about: The only spawn the control role (Plexiform) may ask the session keeper for: a take-over, in exactly the shape board/tasks-engine/engine.js builds it. plan-agent-terminal §R3.2.2. scripts/build-keeper.sh generates the keeper's Swift table from this file (PR 0); src/keeper-protocol/takeover-shape.js reads it directly. Anything outside it is SPAWN_REFUSED, reason 'shape'.
codexNote: PR 0 writes Codex's exact argv shape here (§R3.2.2). Until then a Codex take-over is outside the shape.
filesystem: Realpath, ownership, mode and the cwd/run-dir/cache-dir placement checks need the real files and are the keeper's (PR 0) and T3's; this file pins structure only.
